segments.name: Multiplatform Group
segments.evidence: The Multiplatform Group includes our Markets Group, which includes our 860+ broadcast radio stations in approximately 160 markets; our Events business, which includes both live and virtual events; our SmartAudio suite of data targeting and attribution products; Premiere Networks, which includes the Premiere Networks syndication business and Total Traffic and Weather Network; BIN: Black Information Network and our National Sales Organization.

segments.name: Digital Audio Group
segments.description: Includes all of the Company's digital businesses, including podcasting, the iHeartRadio digital service, digital ad tech, websites, newsletters and its social media footprint.
segments.evidence: Digital Audio Group , which includes all of the Company's Digital businesses including podcasting, the iHeartRadio digital service, its digital advertising technology companies, its websites, newsletters and digital services and programs; and its audio industry-leading social media footprint

segments.name: Audio & Media Services Group
segments.description: Provides media representation services through Katz Media Group and scheduling and broadcast software and services through RCS Sound Software to the industry at large.
segments.evidence: Audio & Media Services Group , which provides other audio and media services, including the Company's media representation business, Katz Media Group, and RCS Sound Software, a provider of scheduling and broadcast software and services to the industry at large.

revenueModel.text: Advertisers pay the Company for advertising time and spots on its broadcast radio stations, syndicated programs, digital platforms and podcasts, plus sponsorship, endorsement, ticket sales and licensing revenue from events.
revenueModel.evidence: Our primary source of revenue is derived from selling advertising time on our domestic broadcast radio stations, generating revenue of $1,633.4 million in 2025, $1,726.9 million in 2024 and $1,752.2 million in 2023.
